canonical_name: Cauchy-Binet determinant formula family for matrix products
literal_source_claim_zh: 矩阵乘积的行列式公式
literal_source_claim_en: The determinant formula for a matrix product.
statement_blocker: The catalog supplies only a theorem name and the gloss 'determinant formula for a matrix product'. It gives no pinpoint source, coefficient domain, matrix dimensions, summation carrier, minor ordering, dimension inequality, or degenerate-case policy, and does not distinguish the full rectangular Cauchy-Binet sum from square determinant multiplicativity. Selecting an exact root at intake would invent proposition-changing mathematics.

canonical_formal_target.candidate_expression: fun {m n : Nat} {R : Type} [CommRing R] (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) R) (B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin m) R) => (A * B).det = sum S : Set.powersetCard (Fin n) m, (A.submatrix id (Set.powersetCard.ofFinEmbEquiv.symm S)).det * (B.submatrix (Set.powersetCard.ofFinEmbEquiv.symm S) id).det
